displayName: LowFlow JR Series high pressure reducing regulator
note: Extracted by hand from the ordering schematic on pages 14 and 15. The code reads model JR, size, material, then seventeen character positions: 1 end connection, 2 port configuration, 3&4 trim, 5&6 seat (material by Cv), 7&8 range spring, 9&10 diaphragm, 11&12 actuator, 13&14 inlet gauge, 15 outlet gauge, 16 SEP compliance, 17 accessories. Assembled without separators, the CV3000 precedent. Held for John: (1) the seat Cv digit is constrained to match the trim Cv, inferred from the two positions sharing the same Cv enumeration, not printed as a rule; (2) position 15 prints a two-character ZZ non-standard code though it is a single-character position, omitted here as a datasheet anomaly; (3) bare 'jr' is deliberately not a match phrase, too loose. The gauge-span liability note is encoded as cautions, stated plainly and never blocking, exactly as the datasheet frames it: the customer assumes responsibility when a selected gauge span does not fully cover the range spring / outlet pressure option. The inlet-gauge caution uses the range spring top as the minimum span, since the true requirement depends on the customer's supply pressure, which the matrix cannot know.
